The structure of Lu4Cu12Te4 (reduced formula LuCu3Te) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for Cu, Lu, and Te centers, each surrounded by four neighbors of the other element at distances of 2.6074 Å, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Corner-sharing is observed between Cu tetrahedra, Cu and Lu tetrahedra, Cu and Te tetrahedra, and Lu and Te tetrahedra.
